description: Source code implementing a hardware-based true random number generator using timing and signal handling, with functions for generating and post-processing random bits.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Sets a timer interval for generating timing-based randomness.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Signal handler for SIGALRM to control timing and randomness collection.

methods.name: roulette
methods.description: Collects timing data and generates a pseudo-random number based on clock skew and OS events.

methods.name: raw_truerand
methods.description: Main function to generate a 32-bit true random number by calling roulette multiple times.
